programme.desc: 強國法爾薩斯的王儲奧斯卡,為了尋找化解自身詛咒的方法而前往魔法強國,鐸洱達爾。在城堡地底長眠的緹娜夏甦醒後雖面露喜色,但現在的奧斯卡卻一頭霧水。法力高強的緹娜夏雖是鐸洱達爾的下一任女王,她卻決定留在法爾薩斯城,幫奧斯卡解開詛咒。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #14
programme.desc: 魔法師雅爾諾為了用人質交換奧斯卡的寶劍——阿卡西亞,操縱強盜團,趁奧斯卡留在城內時抓走緹娜夏,但緹娜夏不肯乖乖就範,與奧斯卡合力討伐了強盜團。而襲擊的背後主使者正是覬覦法爾薩斯的國家,杜爾札。奧斯卡因為擔心爆發戰爭,要緹娜夏返回鐸洱達爾。

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #15
programme.desc: 有人在緹娜夏的杯中下毒,鐸洱達爾的王儲雷吉斯也遭到某人襲擊。正當城內警戒心升高,名叫德莉拉的女性前來晉見,主張她的力量足以承受奧斯卡的詛咒。奧斯卡雖讓她留下,緹娜夏卻無法隱藏自己的不滿。緹娜夏認識的魔族特拉畢斯現身攻擊,讓她身負致命重傷…

programme.title: 無名記憶 (第2季) #16
programme.desc: 東國亞爾達的王女涅菲莉因宮中內亂而暫時住在法爾薩斯。正當緹娜夏和涅菲莉都因為喜歡奧斯卡而意識到了彼此,衝著涅菲莉前來的刺客卻突破了城堡的結界,顯示出內奸的存在。當各國打著自己的如意算盤,亞爾達的侍女卻遭到毒殺,可疑的武官也不知去向。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #1
programme.desc: 西片拿著握力器試圖鍛鍊握力,高木同學卻吐槽說他沒加入運動社團何必鍛鍊,緊接著又使出各種手段捉弄他,西片能不屈服於高木同學,持續鍛鍊握力嗎…?收錄「曬黑」、「新學期」等三個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #2
programme.desc: 上學途中,西片明明感覺到高木同學的氣息卻不見她的蹤影…而高木同學則是尾隨西片不被他發現…這場戰鬥究竟是誰會獲勝呢!?收錄「續・氣息」、「檢查書包」、「圖書股長」、「夕陽」等五個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #3
programme.desc: 分明都10月了卻一早就天氣酷熱,這一天高木同學和西片比平時還早到校。兩人用西片帶的扇子,比賽誰能讓橡皮擦移動得更遠…這場比賽,誰會是贏家…?收錄「魔球」、「拯救貓咪」、「雨」等四個章節。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #1
programme.desc: 為了抗衡來自天界的攻勢,惡魔「阿久津雅虎」前來人間尋找具備領袖特質、能拯救魔界的人才。他隱藏自己的真實身份,轉學至某所高中就讀並遇到了可愛的美少女「天音莉莉」。阿久津認為她可能就是能拯救魔界的「人類」,於是便向她提出邀約,然而……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #2
programme.desc: 阿久津被莉莉制服並成為了她的僕人,被迫協助她狩獵惡魔。阿久津拒絕協助,並表示他寧願被淨化也不願殺死自己的同類。於是莉莉便啟動了套在阿久津頸上的「奪走自由並施以懲罰的頸圈的力量」。然後,阿久津的身體就不由自主地開始動了起來……

programme.title: 海賊王 #7
programme.desc: 為了營救艾斯,白鬍子海賊團與海軍本部、七武海在馬林福特爆發激戰,而魯夫也率領越獄犯加入戰場。魯夫成功救出艾斯,但艾斯卻為了保護他而被赤犬擊殺,白鬍子亦戰死。戰爭最終在紅髮傑克的介入下落幕。經此一戰,魯夫與夥伴們決定分別修行兩年後再會。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #10
programme.desc: 自從與沙迪克決鬥後過了兩個月,高達股份有限公司逐步邁上正軌。兼顧事業與學業的蘇萊塔過著充實的生活。另一邊,作為社長忙碌工作的米奧莉奈則意外地與馮重逢。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #11
programme.desc: 地球宿舍的成員為了取回修理中的風靈,離開了學園。他們要到貝納里特集團的巨大開發設施奎達工廠。然而蘇萊塔卻依舊煩惱著和米奧莉奈間產生的誤解。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #9

programme.title: 海賊王女 #10

programme.title: 海賊王女 #8
programme.desc: 武士們將菲娜從藍巨靈成功帶回來,雪丸卻在過程中受了重傷,為了治療他的傷勢,一行人在紗富彎街稍作停留。紫檀將菲娜稱作魔女後便離開。菲娜看到夥伴因自己而互相對立,開始煩惱是否該繼續旅行。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #9
programme.desc: 阿貝爾回想著少年時期的回憶。他那時因王族末弟的身分被周遭冷眼相待,低調過活。某天他在庭園遇見不可思議的少女海倫娜。隨著共度越多美好時光,雖然深厚的愛情在兩人間慢慢滋長……。此刻菲娜與傷勢好轉的雪丸思考著從石頭得知的神秘座標之謎。

programme.title: 海賊王女 #10
programme.desc: 菲娜一行人順利解開石頭之謎,找出伊甸所在地。她為了面對自身與佛蘭茲留下的謎團,抵達座標標示的無人島。從未見過的神秘景色讓一行人嘆為觀止。這裡是否就是約定之地伊甸?

programme.title: 海賊王女 #11
programme.desc: 一行人到達寶藏沉眠的場所。阿貝爾帶領海兵隊登陸,襲擊武士們。雪丸為了保護菲娜、替佛蘭茲報仇,拔刀與阿貝爾對峙。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #1
programme.desc: 西片拿著握力器試圖鍛鍊握力,高木同學卻吐槽說他沒加入運動社團何必鍛鍊,緊接著又使出各種手段捉弄他,西片能不屈服於高木同學,持續鍛鍊握力嗎…?收錄「曬黑」、「新學期」等三個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #2
programme.desc: 上學途中,西片明明感覺到高木同學的氣息卻不見她的蹤影…而高木同學則是尾隨西片不被他發現…這場戰鬥究竟是誰會獲勝呢!?收錄「續・氣息」、「檢查書包」、「圖書股長」、「夕陽」等五個章節。

programme.title: 擅長捉弄人的高木同學3 #3
programme.desc: 分明都10月了卻一早就天氣酷熱,這一天高木同學和西片比平時還早到校。兩人用西片帶的扇子,比賽誰能讓橡皮擦移動得更遠…這場比賽,誰會是贏家…?收錄「魔球」、「拯救貓咪」、「雨」等四個章節。

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #1
programme.desc: 為了抗衡來自天界的攻勢,惡魔「阿久津雅虎」前來人間尋找具備領袖特質、能拯救魔界的人才。他隱藏自己的真實身份,轉學至某所高中就讀並遇到了可愛的美少女「天音莉莉」。阿久津認為她可能就是能拯救魔界的「人類」,於是便向她提出邀約,然而……

programme.title: 愚蠢天使與惡魔共舞 #2
programme.desc: 阿久津被莉莉制服並成為了她的僕人,被迫協助她狩獵惡魔。阿久津拒絕協助,並表示他寧願被淨化也不願殺死自己的同類。於是莉莉便啟動了套在阿久津頸上的「奪走自由並施以懲罰的頸圈的力量」。然後,阿久津的身體就不由自主地開始動了起來……

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #9
programme.desc: 沙迪克使用計謀令高達股份有限公司陷入無法創業的困境。米奧莉奈賭上公司的命運,向他申請決鬥。決鬥條件為六對六的團體戰,但地球宿舍的機動戰士與駕駛員數量卻都不夠……。

programme.title: 機動戰士高達 水星的魔女 #10
programme.desc: 自從與沙迪克決鬥後過了兩個月,高達股份有限公司逐步邁上正軌。兼顧事業與學業的蘇萊塔過著充實的生活。另一邊,作為社長忙碌工作的米奧莉奈則意外地與馮重逢。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #20
programme.desc: 拉格纳在绯红修复的地球仪之间里养好了伤。为了击败翼之血族、拯救丝塔莉亚,他拜托绯红助他一臂之力。但面对有着压倒性力量的卡姆和会时间魔法的奥偍玛蒂亚,绯红认为没有胜算而拒绝。反而要拉格纳依照她的计画行动。拉格纳则以找到了战斗的理由拒绝了。

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #21
programme.desc: 波爾基烏斯與魔像。奧魯特佐拉與銀裝兵團。卡姆與拉格納。戰場被切割成多個局面,當然也更加激烈。原本認為贏面不大的銀裝兵團,則以驚人成長的加魯姆為中心,和佐拉打得不相上下。另一方面,瀕死的絲塔莉亞看著拉格納的戰鬥,這時娜莎蕾亞出現在她的面前…

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #22
programme.desc: 面對在300%狂化下燃燒著生命的佐拉,團員們也賭上性命對抗著。為了回報以壓倒性的領袖魅力帶領成員找到生命之道的絲塔莉亞,每個人都激發了自身超越極限的力量。這時,被緋紅逼入絕境的奧偍瑪蒂亞,腦海中浮現了還是人類時的記憶…

programme.title: 克拉龍人拉格納 #23
programme.desc: 波爾基烏斯試圖以尼貝利姆託付給他的強大力量控制周圍,將奧偍瑪蒂亞從緋紅的異空間救出來。但一名應該早就被打倒的男人,突然從奇美拉之中出現,擋住他的去路。在翼之血族走投無路時,卡姆想起了讓他嘗到敗仗的殺盡龍,基爾賽雅,那是個與他不分軒輊的強者。

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國﹑英國﹑ 瑞士﹑澳洲﹑土耳其﹑以色列﹑埃及﹑中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受祂對我們的恩典及愛護,同時亦透過昔日方舟洪水及今日全球暖化問題的共同處,啟示人類身為地球管理者,應該好好珍惜及保護地球的責任,改變世界,從你開始。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷奇教練等。藉著十個見證者的親身經歷,讓觀眾明白他們如何靠著基督信仰跨過生命中最難熬過的難關。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 教會的奧秘-吳宣倫博士
創世電視復興祭壇
programme.desc: 與影音使團創世電視成為一家人,一起在「創世電視復興祭壇」,以禱告和敬拜守望香港。

programme.title: 屬靈教室:蔡錦圖博士-小先知書的大意義
programme.desc: #VALUE!

programme.title: 屬靈教室:劉銳光牧師-羅馬書
programme.desc: 曾擔任香港海外神學院院長12年,在香港、菲律賓和美國洛杉磯有40年牧會經驗的劉銳光牧師,將會深入淺出講解一個關乎基督教信仰核心的經卷─《羅馬書》與今日信徒的關係。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地的見證人,100篇令人萬萬想不到的劇本,配以嶄新的拍攝和剪接手法,滋潤都市人的心靈,帶來生命的覺醒。

programme.title: 主日講壇-中國基督教播道會同福堂
programme.desc: 中國基督教播道會同福堂 講題:從恐懼到敬畏神 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 榮主的職場
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《榮主的職場》。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.desc: 天行聖經教會 講題: 活出盼望在今天日(二) 人每一天都要面對很多抉擇,要將上帝的智慧應用在生活不同層面中是一件不容易的事情,而在牧師和傳道人的講道中,往往都能夠得到啟迪。透過主日講壇,更明白神的道並在生活中尋求到神喜悅的心意。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-「不由你不信之從靈界迷惑到真相大白 」
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 寇紹涵牧師-哥林多前書
programme.desc: 保羅教導當地的聖徒如何促進教會內的合一、如何學習神的事。透過寇紹涵牧師講解,進深研讀記載在哥林多前書中保羅的教導,即使周遭充斥著許多邪惡的事物,亦幫助我們明白要過正義生活的教義和原則。

programme.title: 福音電影: 亞洲英雄-沒有硝煙的戰爭
programme.desc: 自古亂世出英雄,在2003年春天的一場沒有硝煙的戰爭中,一群捨己救人的真英雄誕生了。在一輪出生入死的拚搏過後,寫下了香港杏林史上引以為傲的一頁,亦叫早己冷卻的心再一次跳動。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《聖經》實戰攻略
programme.desc: 節目按不同主題,包括︰職場、家庭、戀愛、情緒、信仰生命,邀請七位牧者從《聖經》經文結合生活例子與大家一同靈修,建立一個不離地的信徒生命。

programme.title: 麥希真牧師 末了的話 榮主的職場
programme.desc: 麥希真牧師:「我是八十三歲很老很老的基督工人,『還有末了的話』(林後13:11)要告訴你們。你們都是主要大用的基督工人,若稍為留心這些十分重要『末了的話』,也許有一點助益的。」麥希真牧師將《末了的話》分成八個部分共34個題目,此部為《榮主的職場》。

programme.title: 劉三論今-風風雨雨牽手情
programme.desc: 聖經上說:「人的怒氣,並不成就神的義」,你怎麼靠著神,在處理夫妻之間的矛盾中經歷得勝?創世電視「信仰生活」系列 《劉三論今》,以聖經觀點來講述婚姻家庭的重要性,加進動畫、話劇、布偶及演奏的不同元素,以接地氣的輕鬆方式來教導我們婚姻家庭的經營。

programme.title: 王一平牧師-一言道破
programme.desc: 王一平牧師全新講道系列︰一言道破,以精闢的教導,讓你重新認識敬拜、恩典、事奉、平安的涵意,讓聖靈重新提醒我們,怎樣做一個真基督徒。

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

鳳凰洲際快車 (16226)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰洲際快車》是鳳凰衛視子夜時段的新聞資訊節目,為您帶來兩岸三地,以及國際社會的大小新聞、最新動態和局勢發展。

programme.title: 文化大觀園 (461)
programme.desc: 《文化大觀園》:節目關注中華文化中的大事件、大歷史、大人物和新發現,在紛繁的生活中給您清靜、雅致的空間,並通過我們的鏡頭去探尋中華文明中充滿迷幻、離奇的人物和故事。

programme.title: 鳳凰大健康 (373)
programme.desc: 《鳳凰大健康》:節目將由來自中西醫的健康科普專家和全球首個“智能醫生組成健康科普主持團,並將每期邀請一位頂級醫療專家作為嘉賓,集合中西的理論精華,配合妙趣橫生的人工智慧互動對熱點的健康科普話題進行權威深入解讀。

programme.title: 紀錄大時代 (1415)
programme.desc: 《紀錄大時代》:紀錄珍貴片段,重溫精彩大時代,《紀錄大時代》為您精選鳳凰優秀紀錄片,把歷史再次真實地呈現眼前。

programme.title: 香港新視點 (493)
programme.desc: 《香港新視點》透過訪問特區政府官員、學者、焦點事件的相關人物,以及採訪兩地的年輕人的交流團等,讓觀眾透徹了解香港以至內地政治文化,加深對國情的認識。

programme.title: 新聞今日談 (15226)
programme.desc: 《新聞今日談》:節目針對當天最熱門時事問題,在觀眾最關注的時刻即時作出評論,讓觀眾更洞悉事件的真相。

programme.title: 築夢天下 (468)
programme.desc: 《築夢天下》尋找中外不同風格的建築、民居,道出背後的環境因素和地理條件,詳述生活於其間的人物,細訴人和建築之間糾纏不清的故事。

programme.title: 風雲對話 (407)
programme.desc: 《風雲對話》是一個高素質的訪談節目,節目採訪全球“最關鍵、最前線、最敏感權傾一時的掌權者,他們影響並決定著整個國際局勢的變化和發展。一個個世界級人物在節目中,親自向您剖析他們的觀點。

programme.title: 近觀中國 (212)
programme.desc: 《近觀中國》:全新推出的觀察類紀錄片欄目。每一期以一名外國人為主角,遊走中國各地,以近距離的視角觀察中國社會狀況和中國人的生活。

programme.title: 我的香港故事 (212)
programme.desc: 《我的香港故事》:人物記錄專題欄目。通過每集大約15分鐘的精致篇幅,講述香港人的故事與發生的事。為全國華人觀眾,了解香港新的視覺。

programme.title: 笑逐言開 (616)
programme.desc: 《笑逐言開》是節目運用嶄新的多媒體手段和獨特的串連解讀方式,通過主持人現場脫口秀來演繹各類資訊,帶給您更有營養的週末。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#38粵
programme.desc: 溢滿對新款PDA手提電話心動，可是訂價太貴，他吃朱古力時咬到金幣，竟中獎得到該款手提電話，溢滿將金幣藏在糯米中。溢滿發現粽內竟沒金幣，有義說吃粽時得到中獎金幣，更將金幣送給溢滿，溢滿終坦承一切。

programme.title: 天龍八部#11粵普PG
programme.desc: 阿朱中了玄慈大師的大金剛掌，雖被喬峯救下，卻命在旦夕。喬峯得知薛神醫要在聚賢莊舉行英雄大會，便冒險帶阿朱前去求醫，卻遭到各路英雄冷嘲熱諷。喬峯斷然喝下絕交酒，與在場英雄往日舊情一筆勾銷…

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
阿爺廚房粵
programme.desc: 南海獅山鎮盛產雷公鑿苦瓜，鼎爺和阿譚在當地嚐一頓苦瓜宴。回到香港，鼎爺即席鮮榨苦瓜汁，巧製甜品「苦瓜紅豆糕」，有何方法令紅豆平均分佈？再來「苦瓜炒蛋」，鼎爺預先備好芡汁，烹調時先炒苦瓜後加雞蛋，淋上芡汁，阿譚的兒時美食登場！鼎爺帶阿譚到澳門品嚐「澳門三寶」中的厴仔蟹、烏魚佳餚；返港更找來餘下一寶的矜貴野生方利，炮製「古法荷葉蒸方利」，下鑊前卻要留意清潔魚身的方法。方利味淡，鼎爺用上甚麼配料來取味？

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite 呈獻：滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 農曆新年其間，長者的飲食與作息容易被打亂，特別是三高患者更要注意。老人科醫生提醒，賀年糖果、糕點容易令血糖升高，建議長者多攝取蛋白質食物。有高血壓問題的老友記，醫生提醒過新年亦宜保持清淡飲食、定時服藥，並維持規律作息。新春妝容講求精神奕奕，如出現黑眼圈、眼睛浮腫等問題，怎樣處理？專業化妝師示範相關化妝技巧，助大家營造逆齡效果，以最佳狀態迎接馬年。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範「燉羊肚菌湯」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在廣州粵
programme.desc: 廣州，粵菜發源地之一，廣府菜的中心，是每一位食客都無法拒絕的美食聖地。愛吃愛玩的主持人麥包，在廣州徹底釋放了吃貨天性，走遍大街小巷，尋找地道美食：悠閑早茶、西關小吃、新潮佳饌，夜市小攤

programme.title: 單戀雙城#11粵
programme.desc: 展禛逼錢進教她做甜品。洪叔洪嬸的訪問受歡迎，尼斯被形容為浪漫酒店，劉音得到啟發，邀式適協助做計劃書。式適以掛念父親為由辭職，錢進得知後也想辭職。書舒透露專榮收了警告信，需把居屋單位出租作開源節流。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 情人節來臨，適逢社區舉行義賣會，宏志代人穿上兔子戲服，危急中扶了媽媽一把，其他人卻沒發現。天氣寒冷，嫲嫲教小丸子肚皮用力的御寒方法，後來小丸子自行創出想像自己身處夏天的怪招。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 農曆新年臨近，在家居擺放年桔寓意大吉大利。本集「Artspiration」中，子健哥哥將教大家繪畫年桔，大家可跟隨指引完成作品，再把畫作張貼在家中，不僅增添過年氛，也可感受創作樂趣。一於趕快準備好紙和筆，並細心留意子健哥哥的示範技巧。這次「開心SHARE」的主題，是「我最喜歡的動物」，小朋友投稿分享繪畫了熊貓、北極狐、海豚等動物的圖畫，洋溢童真。這些作品亦喚起主持姐姐們對相關動物的回憶與興趣。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 維多利亞有感可愛力量不足，繼而向珠希求助。珠希見狀，便舉辦一個名為「Victoria可愛精選」的活動，向全校師生招募他們心目中的可愛事物。可是，有群相信肌肉就是可愛的學生接連投稿，竟令Aiprigram充斥著熱波老師的……

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
programme.desc: 由獨立屋搬入分層單位，往往需要適應，設計師如何在間隔方面，保留空間感？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 再有港人北上美髮疑受騙，事主於深圳連鎖髮型屋充值，怎料約一年後再光顧，卻被告知因系統轉換、店舖易手等原因無法扣款。事主質疑店方銷售手法，提醒港人預繳式消費時要提高警覺。婆婆帶寵物鸚鵡外出散步遇事故，鸚鵡受驚飛走。有救援組織尋獲疑似走失的鸚鵡，婆婆遂聯絡組織負責人郭秀雲提出認領。然而交接時，婆婆認為該鸚鵡並非自己的愛鳥，並指控郭秀雲私藏鸚鵡。其後，郭秀雲更收到恐嚇字條……另介紹中環海濱的賀歲好去處。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2745粵
programme.desc: 速熊對面的單位，開設了新的物流公司，成功以宣傳技倆搶去速熊不少生意。速熊的招牌不及對手，樹根打算更換招牌，卻捨不得斥巨資找人題字。樹仁提出一個解決方法，並與熊家眾人出埠前赴某群島。因某些理由，熊姓人士在島上可獲得貴賓待遇，若水等在島上享有特別福利，樹根更可分文不費，便能訂造速熊的招牌。後來，因發生變故，熊姓人士的福利遭取消，樹根等人為免被追討費用，必須盡快逃離該群島……

programme.title: 非常檢控觀#20粵PG
programme.desc: 熊飛與逸桐和好，逸桐主動表白。善昱出任慶曆慈善基金會主席，希仁鏡反射到被收養的泰國孤兒情緒不安，感疑惑。晶晶在泰國失蹤，湘言收到其求救訊息，熊飛查出源自慶曆資助的兒童院舍，與湘言查看後並無發現，卻引起逸桐嫉妒，熊飛決定跟逸桐說清楚。希仁等暗中查探，懷疑基金會或涉人口販賣。湘言請求善昱幫忙；眾人得悉兒童院舍人員陶誠偉，或跟泰巨有聯繋。湘言設法調查誠偉，得知晶晶似被運至酒店某個房間，遂前往尋找……

programme.title: 歡樂茶飯#12粵普PG
programme.desc: 林晏聽到沈家人被趙王帶走，向趙王堅持一定要見到他們，趙王手下帶林晏趕到牢房時，發現沈家人已經逃走。沈家人稍作休息時，官兵追至，鳳霞讓韶光帶央央先跑，一名官兵緊追不捨，韶光便把央央藏起來，自己引開追兵…

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻：一馬當先行大運粵
programme.desc: 李丞責與《非常檢控觀》演員馬德鐘、賴慰玲、吳偉豪、游嘉欣同吃團年飯，師傅根據九運，提議團隊拍攝超越時空的續集！馬年是帶旺馬德鐘的年份嗎？偉豪想改藝名？測一測字就有指引。文昌位有助學生考取佳績，玲玲師傅提議文具顏色及揮春擺位，以提升學業，也求驅病減煞。主持展望、蒨文向碧霞師傅請教，如何因應睡床方位佈置或更換特定顏色床單，催旺財運？另外，璞初師傅教大家赤腳行「接地氣」增運；法銘師傅則帶來家居開運大法。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 天氣報告粵 及 信輝康養特約︰灣區安老Chill凡體驗粵
廉政行動2024#5粵PG
programme.desc: 廉署接獲匿名信得悉一宗保險有關的行賄案件，投訴人指一班經紀有組織地以不當手法賺取公司佣金，而主腦是樂琦。調查發現樂琦與其中一名女客人黃鳳瑛交往甚密，其丈夫潘德成早前行山意外墮山身亡，意外前不久才買下一筆鉅額人壽，受益人正是鳳瑛，經深入調查後，廉署決定找樂琦和鳳瑛回廉署接受調查。問話期間，樂琦堅持是鳳瑛主動給他30%賠償金作為加速申請賠償的報酬，而另一邊廂鳳瑛卻說是對方向她索取30%的賠償金。正當案件膠著之際，廉署竟然發現德成在香港出現的行蹤……

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 再有港人北上美髮疑受騙，事主於深圳連鎖髮型屋充值，怎料約一年後再光顧，卻被告知因系統轉換、店舖易手等原因無法扣款。事主質疑店方銷售手法，提醒港人預繳式消費時要提高警覺。婆婆帶寵物鸚鵡外出散步遇事故，鸚鵡受驚飛走。有救援組織尋獲疑似走失的鸚鵡，婆婆遂聯絡組織負責人郭秀雲提出認領。然而交接時，婆婆認為該鸚鵡並非自己的愛鳥，並指控郭秀雲私藏鸚鵡。其後，郭秀雲更收到恐嚇字條……另介紹中環海濱的賀歲好去處。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 農曆新年其間，長者的飲食與作息容易被打亂，特別是三高患者更要注意。老人科醫生提醒，賀年糖果、糕點容易令血糖升高，建議長者多攝取蛋白質食物。有高血壓問題的老友記，醫生提醒過新年亦宜保持清淡飲食、定時服藥，並維持規律作息。新春妝容講求精神奕奕，如出現黑眼圈、眼睛浮腫等問題，怎樣處理？專業化妝師示範相關化妝技巧，助大家營造逆齡效果，以最佳狀態迎接馬年。「睇餸食飯」環節，Annie師傅示範「燉羊肚菌湯」。

programme.title: 一條麻甩在廣州粵
programme.desc: 廣州，粵菜發源地之一，廣府菜的中心，是每一位食客都無法拒絕的美食聖地。愛吃愛玩的主持人麥包，在廣州徹底釋放了吃貨天性，走遍大街小巷，尋找地道美食：悠閑早茶、西關小吃、新潮佳饌，夜市小攤

programme.title: 單戀雙城#11粵
programme.desc: 展禛逼錢進教她做甜品。洪叔洪嬸的訪問受歡迎，尼斯被形容為浪漫酒店，劉音得到啟發，邀式適協助做計劃書。式適以掛念父親為由辭職，錢進得知後也想辭職。書舒透露專榮收了警告信，需把居屋單位出租作開源節流。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#38粵
programme.desc: 溢滿對新款PDA手提電話心動，可是訂價太貴，他吃朱古力時咬到金幣，竟中獎得到該款手提電話，溢滿將金幣藏在糯米中。溢滿發現粽內竟沒金幣，有義說吃粽時得到中獎金幣，更將金幣送給溢滿，溢滿終坦承一切。

programme.title: 天龍八部#11粵普PG
programme.desc: 阿朱中了玄慈大師的大金剛掌，雖被喬峯救下，卻命在旦夕。喬峯得知薛神醫要在聚賢莊舉行英雄大會，便冒險帶阿朱前去求醫，卻遭到各路英雄冷嘲熱諷。喬峯斷然喝下絕交酒，與在場英雄往日舊情一筆勾銷…

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 麥美恩、黃耀英、吳幸美挑戰街市檔販對菜、魚、雞相關歇後語的認識。掌故專家鄭寶鴻講解「新澤西」與「石罅米」的出處；大學講師廖舜禧解讀何謂「冇尾燒豬」。耀英、美恩搞笑合演「醉酒佬數街燈」，句末有何妙趣？

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 大學講師廖舜禧在文武廟講解「波羅雞」及「呃鬼食豆腐」相關典故。屏山鄧氏宗祠、覲廷書室古蹟遊，鄧達智介紹分豬肉、謝灶習俗。鄭寶鴻帶來「亞聾送殯」、「撒路溪錢」的出處。主持還鬼馬演繹「盲公食雲吞」。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
香港早晨粵 及 亞太眼科學會特約:香港眼科 · 全球視野粵
隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 文房四寶中的墨, 製作步驟比起其他三寶都要複雜 本集會介紹用松樹等大自然材料, 經過火燒、搓揉等多重步驟製造出的松煙墨, 不只保留松樹獨有的氣節和松香, 更是書生們書房裡的珍貴寶物

programme.title: 世界獨特社區粵普
programme.desc: 荷蘭是個重視長者照護與福利的國家，推出多種養老模式，幫老人保持身體健康, 擁有積極的生活態度，良好的自理能力。清邁以國外老人為主的高級療養園，老人在這裡有個人空間、還有專業看護照顧，過著渡假般的生活。

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 三位美女帶諾懿走進菜園，親手採摘新鮮食材。高Ling雀躍地摘取樹上的椰子，卻又懼怕蟲子，畫面趣怪！甫看到園內的鞦韆玩意，一行人頓變大細路，展現童真一面。滿載而歸後，眾人邊嚐有機火鍋邊細訴理想退休環境，諾懿、敏之、嘉欣皆希望開設自家農莊，享受樸素生活。來到勞勿的度假村，諾懿、高Ling勇闖熱帶雨林冒險，還揚言要挑戰跳瀑布……探險之後，二人獲敏之、嘉欣以美點慰勞，並暢談跳瀑布威水史，為何卻不禁偷笑？

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 荃灣、葵青遍佈街坊熟悉、但外來人未必認識的消閒好去處。「游生」袁文傑、林韋辰、丁子朗三位型男於周末結伴同行，齊齊發掘兩區吃喝玩樂熱點。「期間限定」樓梯畫突破視覺空間；試玩巨型象棋、麻雀，樂趣滿分！清早到訪荃灣川龍品嚐山水靚茶，歎盡寫意人生。43條天橋連貫大小商場，交織出「離地」購物之樂。深井甜品遠近馳名，路德圍食店越夜越美味！遠眺壯麗青馬大橋之外，三人還會走進涌美老屋村，尋找傳統客家風味！

programme.title: 周六聊Teen谷粵
programme.desc: 從心理學角度切入，快樂是一種感到幸福、滿足、愉快的心理狀態，其來源可能包括健康、安全、愛與成就感等，谷主凱婷更找來一條「快樂方程式」，如何計算？據指在心理學上有三大不快樂因素，會是甚麼？有機構評選出，芬蘭連續八年蟬聯全球最幸福國家或地區的榜首，眾谷主談論當地民眾的快樂泉源，笑言跟他們在職時可享四星期暑假有莫大關係。凱婷又與泳嘉、凱文討論如何獲取快樂，提出要做到知行合一、避免與別人過份比較等方法。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 煮東煮西粵
programme.desc: 澱粉食物識得煮，也可發揮均衡飲食之道。燕麥米含有豐富膳食纖維，混合白米，健康昇華！保哥用蝦乾、銀魚乾炮製中式荷葉飯，家嘉則以鴨腿、鵝油奉上法式煲仔飯，同樣是中秋聚餐之選。過節必備「笑蝦蝦」，保哥以茄汁大蝦配煎米粉，還提示詩雅將生蝦浸冰水會較易去殼；米粉要煎得乾身脆口，又有甚麼秘訣？家嘉將ABC粉、牛肉搓成肉丸再炸，賣相味道兼備，為食翠如吃不停！最後以嚳儀巧製的「抺茶忌廉芝士奶凍」作結，才算圓滿！

programme.title: 諸朋戀友粵
programme.desc: 陳展鵬、黎諾懿、徐榮、陸浩明帶同另一半放閃，六號還攜來女友每年的驚喜小手作。徐榮夫婦難忘在產房度過情人節；諾懿竟為放棄照顧伴侶，而於對方生日派對灌醉自己？展鵬不時在紀律部隊題材劇集展示體能，現實中也曾為單文柔來回跑廿幾層樓梯？情人節非戀人專利，方力申、連詩雅、郭子豪、江嘉敏、孔德賢、游嘉欣也來湊熱鬧，「圍爐分析」單身原因。初次約會應否展現真性情？嘉欣、子豪各有經歷。德賢則接受不了女生太快愛上自己？

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 大部份人對「男、女」有既定概念，主持洪永城要求五位小朋友就着吃甜品、打架、八卦等較切合男或女來投票，結果如何？從名字可否判斷一個人是男是女？首集請來六位藝人讓小朋友競猜。乍聽「鄧英敏」這名字，眾人都一致覺得是女性，「黃梓瑋」也令大家十分混亂。另外，其中兩位女生提及女士太健壯並不合乎漂亮的「標準」，更有人認為跳舞、繪畫等較優雅的活動才適合女性。永城引領三位女生挑戰忍者式體能鍛練，她們試玩後可會改觀？

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵
programme.desc: 今年是人類充滿惶恐不安的一年，網絡上流傳不少大災難的預言：中東戰火、日本超級大地震等，我們的明天究竟會怎樣呢？很多人想預知未來，研究它的真假，在網絡資訊爆炸的時代，越講越真，越知道反而越驚，就好像聖經一早預言：『人想起將要臨到世界的事，就嚇得魂不附體』這一刻，站在文明懸崖上的我們，是否正要見證這古老預言成為現實？在全新一輯的地球大神秘，我們會繼續從世界各地神秘事件，探討各種預言的真確，還會同被稱為最準確重要的預言書《聖經》作對比，在末世中得到真正的平安保障。

programme.title: 後空翻少年粵日
programme.desc: 懷著最壞的打算，翔太郎在志田教練批准下帶傷上陣，並在比賽後立即到醫院驗傷。在檢查途中，翔太郎一直惦記大賽結果，但是，無論是與他同行的美里，還是其他隊員，竟然都對賽果三緘其口……

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 這次「WORKOUT 2GETHER」由歐鴻斌教練指引大家做肌耐力與協調能力運動。抬腿及摺腿的動作看似相近，但實際上有何分別？外八字腳連續半蹲，馬步要夠穩，腰要挺直！然後拿出阻力帶，轉為兩人一組，合拍地完成指定動作，看看誰能支撐較久。接着以小球作輔助工具，投入協調能力訓練。在不看球的情況下，能否順利做到彈地接球？將球分別夾於大腿、小腿與腳踝位置，並原地跳，難度越來越高，在場小朋友都專注完成挑戰。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 查查林部隊粵英
programme.desc: 森林裡神秘怪事頻生。巨大陷阱出現，栗子消失，昆蟲失蹤，橡實從天而降！要交由大偵探Peet和朋友Baba和Molly組成的查查林部隊調查。牠們未必是最能幹的偵探隊，但往往能夠迎刃而解，揭開大自然奧秘。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 豬太郎幫老婆婆過馬路，收到巧克力作為回禮，誰知被同學誤以為是情人節巧克力，掀起一場風波。學校即將舉行馬拉松比賽，令小丸子心情鬱結，爺爺受到電視節目啟發，決定自告奮勇擔任其教練。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 新聞透視粵 及 亞太眼科學會特約:香港眼科 · 全球視野粵
programme.desc: 本台發現有人懷疑非法開墾政府土地，在山頭開路，政府會如何執法？過去5年，當局合共處理接近六萬宗霸地個案，只有98宗被檢控。有人承認在政府土地，興建設施及放置私人物品20年，就算經地政署確認涉及非法佔用政府用地，違法建構物至今仍然未移除，也無人被檢控，為甚麽？2015年政府增加首次非法佔用政府用地定罪罰款，由罰款1萬增至50萬，是否有足夠阻嚇力？

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 京東呈獻：愛心改造家粵
programme.desc: 三十出頭的晴晴，失婚後跟一對兒女暫住母親家中，直至最近終可「上樓」，決意為子女打造最溫馨的家。晴晴提到會在家中工作，只要劃出客廳區域設置工作台，就可邊用電腦剪片，邊看顧兩兄妹。宅Sir為將來會再長高的十歲哥哥選擇木床，指出床的長度隨時可延伸，改造性夠高！晴晴選用覆合材料為全屋鋪地板，有何優點？不過，廚房及廁所門口卻不宜鋪地氈？森美、璇璇隨同晴晴一家三口參觀新居，甫開門，兒子直言仿如走進了示範單位！

programme.title: AlipayHK 呈獻:唱錢粵
programme.desc: 音準、拍子大考驗，唱歌隨時有錢落袋！來自馬來西亞的《中年好聲音3》亞軍唱將張與辰接受《唱錢》洗禮，透過挑戰Sing盤上不同歌曲難度「過三關」，甚至是最難的Monster關卡，向掃清九宮格的目標進發。觀眾只需用手機掃描螢幕上的QR Code，即可參與直播室互動，為挑戰者打氣，更有機會贏取福利。

programme.title: J Music粵
programme.desc: 關智斌在啟德舉行個唱後，即將於澳門再開騷，演出上有甚麼調整？除了送上兩首跳唱歌，他亦藉<My Little Tinker Bell感謝身邊眾人一直以來的支持。許靖韻赴佛山巡唱前，以<請勿打擾作熱身。吳若希分享台上唱錯歌詞的趣事，這次演繹<超前告別又可會「蝦碌」？適逢情人節，主持冼靖峰、李尹嫣「一晚限定」合唱甜蜜冧歌<勁浪漫 超溫馨。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 新春大吉，暉哥偕同鼎爺前往品嚐特色淮揚菜，包括文思豆腐松葉蟹、雙剁椒鳳凰鴿等菜式，刀工精細，各有特別寓意，吉祥如意！星廚莫燦霖帶波波造訪一間「人氣」餐廳，細嚐椒麻芥末熗花甲、陳皮欖角田雞臘腸煲仔飯等佳餚，滿是驚喜滋味！蕭欣浩博士則與伍倩彤一起養生進補，享用太史五蛇羹、生扣蛇骨腩等美食，並細說食蛇的「嚐識」。黃嘉雯駕車帶胡美貽上山頂「搵食」，品嚐三色雜錦小籠包、宮保蝦球等特色上海佳餚，別具風味！

programme.title: J Sport粵
programme.desc: 跆拳道女將江麗莉登上世界排名第三；壁球代表劉子均首奪亞錦賽金牌，二人訴說2025年深刻點滴。網球港隊於台維斯盃不敵芬蘭隊，無緣升上世界一組，黃澤林賽後細談感受。國際馬術盛典音樂騎術表演中，看到退役賽駒身影，箇中「轉型」道路是怎樣的？港隊於公路單車亞錦賽收穫佳績，日前凱旋返港。體院開放日吸引市民參觀；體操名將石偉雄出席活動，推動大家多做運動。另有滑浪風翼世界盃香港站戰報，及全運會港區義工表揚禮花絮。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵 及 天氣報告粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 玩轉香港日與夜粵
programme.desc: 荃灣、葵青遍佈街坊熟悉、但外來人未必認識的消閒好去處。「游生」袁文傑、林韋辰、丁子朗三位型男於周末結伴同行，齊齊發掘兩區吃喝玩樂熱點。「期間限定」樓梯畫突破視覺空間；試玩巨型象棋、麻雀，樂趣滿分！清早到訪荃灣川龍品嚐山水靚茶，歎盡寫意人生。43條天橋連貫大小商場，交織出「離地」購物之樂。深井甜品遠近馳名，路德圍食店越夜越美味！遠眺壯麗青馬大橋之外，三人還會走進涌美老屋村，尋找傳統客家風味！

programme.title: 仨心友行粵
programme.desc: 三位美女帶諾懿走進菜園，親手採摘新鮮食材。高Ling雀躍地摘取樹上的椰子，卻又懼怕蟲子，畫面趣怪！甫看到園內的鞦韆玩意，一行人頓變大細路，展現童真一面。滿載而歸後，眾人邊嚐有機火鍋邊細訴理想退休環境，諾懿、敏之、嘉欣皆希望開設自家農莊，享受樸素生活。來到勞勿的度假村，諾懿、高Ling勇闖熱帶雨林冒險，還揚言要挑戰跳瀑布……探險之後，二人獲敏之、嘉欣以美點慰勞，並暢談跳瀑布威水史，為何卻不禁偷笑？

programme.title: 成人教科書粵
programme.desc: 大部份人對「男、女」有既定概念，主持洪永城要求五位小朋友就着吃甜品、打架、八卦等較切合男或女來投票，結果如何？從名字可否判斷一個人是男是女？首集請來六位藝人讓小朋友競猜。乍聽「鄧英敏」這名字，眾人都一致覺得是女性，「黃梓瑋」也令大家十分混亂。另外，其中兩位女生提及女士太健壯並不合乎漂亮的「標準」，更有人認為跳舞、繪畫等較優雅的活動才適合女性。永城引領三位女生挑戰忍者式體能鍛練，她們試玩後可會改觀？

programme.title: 手匠傳承粵韓
programme.desc: 文房四寶中的墨, 製作步驟比起其他三寶都要複雜 本集會介紹用松樹等大自然材料, 經過火燒、搓揉等多重步驟製造出的松煙墨, 不只保留松樹獨有的氣節和松香, 更是書生們書房裡的珍貴寶物

programme.title: 隆行天下之重走八千里路雲和月普
粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 麥美恩、黃耀英、吳幸美挑戰街市檔販對菜、魚、雞相關歇後語的認識。掌故專家鄭寶鴻講解「新澤西」與「石罅米」的出處；大學講師廖舜禧解讀何謂「冇尾燒豬」。耀英、美恩搞笑合演「醉酒佬數街燈」，句末有何妙趣？

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 大學講師廖舜禧在文武廟講解「波羅雞」及「呃鬼食豆腐」相關典故。屏山鄧氏宗祠、覲廷書室古蹟遊，鄧達智介紹分豬肉、謝灶習俗。鄭寶鴻帶來「亞聾送殯」、「撒路溪錢」的出處。主持還鬼馬演繹「盲公食雲吞」。

programme.title: 大玩特玩粵
programme.desc: 眾藝員先以身體部位的粗幼長短分組，輸家全落入特玩隊，是否代表勝出機會渺茫？楊潮凱有獨特策略，「分拆」肉丸擊倒保齡球樽搶分！自稱「夜蒲之王」的翟威廉挑戰乒乓過三關，卻發覺愛蒲高手多的是！黃美棋隨便的一拋便能成功入球，進一步削減威廉士氣。當眾人已不看好他時，他卻施展非一般腰力，單腳站着叼起地面上的紙張，令人刮目相看。眾人落力踏單車爭出線，何浩文化身魔鬼教練督促隊員，落場時卻玩得臉青唇白，最終會否輸掉？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 兩組實習生的導師李德紅和李蓉分別因為休假和參加培訓而迎來了代班導師牟長雨和胡榮強，實習生們和兩位導師會產生什麼樣的化學作用呢？另外為了慶祝將滿一歲的鑫鑫的寶寶，馬余英和金奕霖準備給牠做一個食物豐容…

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 隨著寶石時裝大賽進入倒數階段，大賽便成為了閃亮宿的熱話。據說大賽獎品鑽石造型能夠實現任何夢想，令到寶石偶像都開始談起她們的心願，因而激發了奈瑠的興趣，想打聽大家有著什麼夢想，可是……

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日 及 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 最近沒看到黛雅做節目，奇蹟閃耀組與虹之咲都為此感到擔心，希望前往虛擬世界見她一面。玫兒見狀，便即場發明傳送機器，並由Meltic StAr與虹之咲一起到虛擬世界找出黛雅，但虛擬世界似乎在發生異變……

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄被嘲笑不懂砌模型，多啦A夢於是借他「地球套餐」，讓他創建小型地球，誰知地球被媽媽扔掉，造成大災難。大雄等人為了爭奪豬肉包，被迫與胖虎玩捉迷藏，多啦A夢借出「魔術拉鍊」助其一把。

programme.title: B-PROJECT超星團粵日
programme.desc: KiLLER KiNG知道他們的新歌被選為電影的主題曲後非常開心，但是翼和他們卻被夾在贊助商的意見和自己的希望之間進退兩難，就在這個過程中，彌勒在導演啟發下領略到一個重要道理，帶領成員們走出困局。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 糖妹、谷婭溦置身「魔都」上海，來到地標武康大樓跟前，用小嘴巴淺嚼大樓麵包另類打卡後，啟動「早咖晚酒」生活。大吃手撕豬肉貝果，專家糖妹試後感如何？尋覓隱世小店，必點鎮店菜肉餛飩。醫肚後逛逛街，主打迷你裝束的時尚女裝店，血拼解鎖！走進玻璃屋餐廳，生牛肉塔塔、開心果碎甜蝦等滿桌美食賣相精緻，糖妹品嚐布拉塔芝士，味道「古怪」卻吃不停口？入夜，怎可錯過上海本邦菜，黑松露紅燒肉、松鼠桂魚，打卡指數又有多高？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽和6號前往位於元朗的有機農場，搜羅多種「有營」蔬果，為主打健康的新一輯節目打響頭炮。番茄含有豐富茄紅素，多吃有助保護心臟、預防前列腺疾病。二人試食黑皮車厘茄，竟滲出陣陣煙肉風味！製作「羽衣甘藍番茄藜麥乾果沙律」，務要將蔬菜切碎，當中有何飲食智慧？「南瓜粟米腰果湯」滋補脾胃；另一道「南瓜湯浸比目魚」做法簡單，奧米加3卻有護眼強腦功效。「煎焗無激素雞」選用丹麥自然放養雞，嫩滑雞胸更令肥媽情有獨鍾。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽今回選用鴨的多個部位煮出四道美饌，果然「點煮都Duck」！「白滷水鴨」香濃味美，與有色滷水汁有何不同？啤梨搭配鴨肝同吃，可中和油膩感。一道「煎鴨肝燴啤梨」講求火候掌控，6號卻以慢活節奏為啤梨切片，阿媽不禁火起！6號再探有機農場，初嘗翠玉瓜人工授粉步驟，還替肥媽摘取新鮮的荷蘭豆和甜豆。肥媽以含有高蛋白質、鐵質的鴨胸，配合「孖豆」爆炒菜式；再帶來「翠玉彩椒炒鴨腎」，處理鴨腎、鴨心又有甚麼需要注意？

programme.title: 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 災禍無情，為保障生命及財產安全，廣大市民務必時刻保持高度的防災意識。由馮盈盈、何晉樂等「星級」藝員參演的《防災貼士你要知 2》，以短劇形式向大家傳遞防止災害發生、遇危難時逃命的貼士,，還有消防處代表帶來相關知識與實用資訊。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 澄光帶慧中、星妤品嚐潮汕美食「粿汁」，滋味秘密來自一鍋胡椒湯底。四位主持齊齊食漢堡，除牛肉外，用素肉、吞拿魚製成的漢堡扒亦有驚喜。星妤、慧中體驗三款特色水療，何解星妤感覺仿如置身死海？一間店可滿足主持們吃泰菜與歎咖啡兩大要求，供應的泰國東北部菜餚味道有何特色？澄光、慧中尋訪人氣「芒果糯米飯」，據稱做法源於皇官！夜市聚餐由星妤請客，「火山排骨」體積巨大得驚人，還有材料豐富的海鮮拼盤，眾拍檔開懷大嚼。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃曼谷粵
programme.desc: 曼谷的潮式牛腩麵名店，內裡竟可打邊爐？看見海寧在陶瓷上繪畫，原來她置身一間結合手繪陶瓷體驗的咖啡店。店內還遇上狗店長，「女神」更主動求吻！三位女神再次享受矜貴SPA，慧中和星妤的眉心被放上石塊再滴油，感受如何？澄光推介的豬手美食究竟有多滋味，讓星妤不顧儀態一口把豬皮往嘴裡塞？海寧發掘一間環境清新的純素餐廳，並可找到Pizza、擔擔麵等多國食品。慧中、星妤、澄光坐船暢遊湄南河，還以夕陽作伴寫意打卡。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 周奕瑋經常走訪不同國家，因此有機會見識不同甜品。最近，他趁著到日本旅遊機會，品嚐了一款充滿地道風味的抹茶Tiramisu，並希望親手試做，再三回味，甜品達人古嘉俊(阿古)因應他的口味，示範「抹茶藍莓蛋糕」。蛋糕外表色彩繽紛，紫紅色藍莓鏡面配上花花裝飾後，增添和風。至於口味方面，抹茶蛋糕配以藍莓白朱古力慕絲，以創新組合為食家送上新鮮感。向甜品達人偷師當然獲益良多，周奕瑋還尋獲無比樂趣。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 大成太晴的姐姐，天才系統工程師大成伊奈失蹤兩年後，大成轉學到伊奈從前就讀的進開學園，並認識到鐵路部的良太和舞。此時突然傳來警報，睽違十年的怪物再度出現，兩人奉命把太晴帶去超鐵機。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 本集「My Little Show」，一位女生提着花籃跳芭蕾舞，舞姿優雅；另一位女生則以長笛吹奏某齣動畫電影的主題曲，音色柔和動聽。兩項表演各有特色，令人陶醉其中。不少兒歌以健康生活習慣為主題，讓孩子於聆聽歌曲時吸收歌詞中的知識，建立正向生活態度。波波姐姐與主持姐姐合唱<蔬果超人大戰秘秘怪獸、<刷牙歌，節奏輕快有趣。收看節目的小朋友亦可跟着唱，並盡力嘗試培養良好習慣。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 蛙蛙王國舉行紀念舞會，展出國寶「蝌蚪之卵」，詎料放置國寶的房間傳出聲響，芝娃娃局長更涉嫌偷竊國寶，為證明其清白，汪汪警察局與名犬警察局破天荒首次合作，在屁屁偵探帶領下追捕真正犯人。

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 俊子透過有獎賀年明信片，得到了一些獎品。見此，小丸子決意核對所有收到的賀年明信片有否中獎。經過一輪核對之後，終於發現有一張是中了獎的。但是，那張中了獎的明信片上，卻寫著一些令小丸子困惑的字句。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 這十年幸福中國粵
programme.desc: 本片從城市到鄉村，以科技、社會、民生、體育、文化等多個角度出發，用小故事展現大主題、用小視角透視大時代，記錄各行各業普通人的工作與生活，體現幸福是奮鬥出來的思想。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 星期日檔案粵 及 防災貼士你要知2粵
programme.desc: 高學歷、高收入、高職位的女士，不止難找另一半，要與生理時鐘競賽，孕育下一代就更難。不少女性選擇雪卵，留待日後受孕生育，甚至有單身女士選擇到外地借精生子。隨著去年12月1日，本港女士以非醫學原因，只可以雪卵十年的限制正式取消，女士是否更有生育自主權？本港企業又會否仿傚大型美資企業，將輔助生育療程納入員工福利呢？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 香港歐化飛鷹活絡油呈獻:中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: 七十強PK戰，來到最終回。蔡宓婕的<給我一個理由忘記，讓海兒「起雞皮」！林靖枝揀選偶像之歌<靈魂相認，透露曾獲「軒公」親自嘉許。上輪奪五燈的科亞高巴再以英文歌出戰，能否延續佳績？另一五燈選手雷小雷柔聲訴說<女人花，周國豐形容像在聽詩篇。某位藉較少燈數入圍的參賽者令評審們眼前一亮，成功晉級。蒙面藝人方面，唐伯虎、鹿七伯、樹熊公子、企鵝人都在這集登場，如未能躋身最後四十強，就要摘下面具離開舞台。

programme.title: 一周星星粵PG
programme.desc: 黃子華曾擔任鄭秀文演唱會嘉賓，當時直言不熟對方，秀文為報恩參演其賀歲片，兩人開始變熟，還聯同戲中演員王丹妮、廖子妤齊齊受訪。片中子華有露上身鏡頭，他自言有演員道德，未有操練時更是「小林雪」？秀文亦憶述體重的上上落落，奉勸觀眾不要「模仿」！問到當年買名車一事，子華似不想答，但面對身旁幾雙好奇眼睛，只好將「黑歷史」公開。丹妮、子妤協力向前輩「本尊Fact Check」，過程可謂一額汗，還擔心有人會嬲？

programme.title: 馬到功成萬象新 2026蓉港新春晚會粵
programme.desc: 香港、成都藝人跨地域匯演，祝願新一年馬到功成，萬象更新！黎耀祥、陳豪、陳展鵬、林夏薇、蕭正楠、吳若希、胡鴻鈞等，以MV形式喚起港劇金曲情懷。謝雪心、謝曉瑩演繹粵劇<求神；「聲夢」歌手聯乘兒童合唱團，頌讚<東方之珠。唐文龍與莫宛螢、高久尚等健兒施展詠春、太極、刀術武藝，奉上「精武」盛宴。蓉港兩地藝人分別獻聲賀新禧；冼靖峰、岳聖傑結伴潮遊雙城食玩潮點。三隊內地人氣女團匯聚成都，舞動節慶歡樂。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 少年中醫說粵普
programme.desc: 節目聚焦於青年族群體驗中醫藥文化，集結中國七所中醫藥的7名高校學子，在主持人和中醫藥名家的帶領下，探尋中華醫聖故裡，以「盲盒路線分組體驗」醫聖故裡的形式，了解醫聖對當代中醫藥發展的啟示。

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 周奕瑋經常走訪不同國家，因此有機會見識不同甜品。最近，他趁著到日本旅遊機會，品嚐了一款充滿地道風味的抹茶Tiramisu，並希望親手試做，再三回味，甜品達人古嘉俊(阿古)因應他的口味，示範「抹茶藍莓蛋糕」。蛋糕外表色彩繽紛，紫紅色藍莓鏡面配上花花裝飾後，增添和風。至於口味方面，抹茶蛋糕配以藍莓白朱古力慕絲，以創新組合為食家送上新鮮感。向甜品達人偷師當然獲益良多，周奕瑋還尋獲無比樂趣。

programme.title: 魔都女行粵
programme.desc: 糖妹、谷婭溦置身「魔都」上海，來到地標武康大樓跟前，用小嘴巴淺嚼大樓麵包另類打卡後，啟動「早咖晚酒」生活。大吃手撕豬肉貝果，專家糖妹試後感如何？尋覓隱世小店，必點鎮店菜肉餛飩。醫肚後逛逛街，主打迷你裝束的時尚女裝店，血拼解鎖！走進玻璃屋餐廳，生牛肉塔塔、開心果碎甜蝦等滿桌美食賣相精緻，糖妹品嚐布拉塔芝士，味道「古怪」卻吃不停口？入夜，怎可錯過上海本邦菜，黑松露紅燒肉、松鼠桂魚，打卡指數又有多高？

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽和6號前往位於元朗的有機農場，搜羅多種「有營」蔬果，為主打健康的新一輯節目打響頭炮。番茄含有豐富茄紅素，多吃有助保護心臟、預防前列腺疾病。二人試食黑皮車厘茄，竟滲出陣陣煙肉風味！製作「羽衣甘藍番茄藜麥乾果沙律」，務要將蔬菜切碎，當中有何飲食智慧？「南瓜粟米腰果湯」滋補脾胃；另一道「南瓜湯浸比目魚」做法簡單，奧米加3卻有護眼強腦功效。「煎焗無激素雞」選用丹麥自然放養雞，嫩滑雞胸更令肥媽情有獨鍾。

programme.title: 食好D 食平D粵
programme.desc: 肥媽今回選用鴨的多個部位煮出四道美饌，果然「點煮都Duck」！「白滷水鴨」香濃味美，與有色滷水汁有何不同？啤梨搭配鴨肝同吃，可中和油膩感。一道「煎鴨肝燴啤梨」講求火候掌控，6號卻以慢活節奏為啤梨切片，阿媽不禁火起！6號再探有機農場，初嘗翠玉瓜人工授粉步驟，還替肥媽摘取新鮮的荷蘭豆和甜豆。肥媽以含有高蛋白質、鐵質的鴨胸，配合「孖豆」爆炒菜式；再帶來「翠玉彩椒炒鴨腎」，處理鴨腎、鴨心又有甚麼需要注意？

programme.title: 熊貓一家人粵普
programme.desc: 兩組實習生的導師李德紅和李蓉分別因為休假和參加培訓而迎來了代班導師牟長雨和胡榮強，實習生們和兩位導師會產生什麼樣的化學作用呢？另外為了慶祝將滿一歲的鑫鑫的寶寶，馬余英和金奕霖準備給牠做一個食物豐容…

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 奇蹟的兄弟(完)
programme.desc: 【《高斯電子公司》裴賢聖不當高富帥，與《精神教練諸葛吉》鄭宇奇蹟相遇】負債累累的熱血青年陸東柱，在以為是人生中最糟糕的一天遇上了特殊神力卻來歷不明名為「奇蹟」的少年。能夠深刻感受別人痛苦與絕望，也能治癒別人。為找回他的過去與記憶，兩人成為了彼此生命中的一個奇蹟相遇。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃

programme.title: 紳士與小姐
programme.desc: 【韓國收視破38%韓版《真善美》重拾幸福時光】《我唯一的守護者》編劇金始慶最新家庭劇新作，與爸爸、繼母一同生活的直率女孩朴丹丹，因繼兄繼母闖禍被詐騙，使得原本不富裕的家庭更加困苦，面對爸爸的偏坦對待，朴丹丹憤而離家，因緣際會下來到有錢人家擔任住宿教師，陪伴失去母親的三個孩子，而他們的爸爸便是高冷霸道總裁李英國，在妻子早逝後，英國的內心漸漸封閉，與孩子間也產生隔閡，好在天真浪漫的朴丹丹出現，加上孩子們的湊合，幸福將再次降臨。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 好搭檔
programme.desc: 【張娜拉火力全開！槓上小三、手撕出軌老公超過癮】王牌律師遇上菜鳥新人，一場法庭與情感的雙重對決即將展開！《好搭檔》講述擁有17年經驗的離婚律師車恩京，在面對丈夫背叛後，與熱血正義的新人韓宥利成為「最不可能搭檔」的辦公室火花組合。冷面魔頭與理想主義者，兩人從互看不順眼，到聯手應對一樁樁離婚官司，解開婚姻背後的人性兩難。冷靜與熱血交織，掀起一場場心碎又痛快的離婚風暴！

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 我的野蠻王妃
programme.desc: 【神級經典韓劇，尹恩惠、朱智勳、金楨勳、宋智孝再現現代宮廷指腹為婚！！】申采靜原本只是一名平凡無奇的高中學生，得知爺爺的遺囑中，她與皇太子李信有婚約在身。因家中債務的原因，在無可奈何的情況完婚。待在皇室的申采靜對宮內生活十分反彈，此時海歸回來的皇位第二繼承者李律及李信前女友閔孝琳的存在，展開錯綜複雜的故事。

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 【《請叫我總監》譚松韻與《清平樂》王凱，飛向天際攜手築夢！！】鷺洲航空客運飛行部副部長顧南亭因公司改制，與性格颯爽不羈的程霄成為上下屬和師徒關係。面對接踵而來的突發航空事件，追求穩定秩序的顧南亭時常被不按常理出牌的程霄打亂計劃，共同經歷衝擊與考驗，一路披荊斬棘、相扶成長。

programme.title: 時光之城
programme.desc: 【橫跨兩國人氣演員的偶像劇，張哲瀚攜手朴敏英初嘗試愛情羅曼史！！】樂觀積極的元氣少女許真，在前往蓋亞影視應徵時撞見了當紅炸子雞顧持鈞被前女友拒絕的場面。不希望丟臉的事情曝光的顧持鈞則從中作梗想趕走許真，卻陰錯陽差的在蓋亞集團二公子林晉修的幫助下，反而成為了顧持鈞的助理。朝夕相處、情愫蔓延，卻同時捲入了集團的陰謀，兩人要如何逃出危機，讓有情人終成眷屬呢?

programme.title: 愛情是Beautiful，人生是Wonderful
programme.desc: 【《月水金火木土》金宰永攜手《社內相親》薛仁雅尋找幸福小確幸！！！】清雅是一名放棄戀愛和結婚，努力在生活中，連續八年準備警察公務員卻無法合格的社會小螺絲。俊輝則是一名對他人毫無興趣的不婚主義者，不管是愛情、友情還是親情都秉持N分之一的態度。認識了彼此開始尋找瑣碎但現實的小確幸，並開始認知愛情是美好的人生是精彩的。

programme.title: 珠玉在側
programme.desc: 【不務正業公子雯珺陰錯陽差納ㄚ環玉薦師徐璐！！】個性古靈精怪的單單單，一心想成為薦玉師卻苦無機會，只能幫姐姐單雙雙賣些假玉，一次交易過程中無意得罪了富家玩絝公子裴沛，彼此留下很差的印象。又因突發危機單單單走投無路入府成為ㄚ環，府邸主人意外是裴沛，單單單也在調笑皆非中與裴沛逐漸相知相惜。

programme.desc: As a nurse, Coffy (Pam Grier) has seen the ill effects of drugs up close, but it isn't until her little sister becomes addicted to heroin that she finally decides to wage a one-woman battle. Disguised as a prostitute, Coffy goes on a killing rampage, at first going after street dealers and pimps such as sleazy King George (Robert DoQui), then gradually working her way up to bigger honchos. She's shocked, however, when she discovers that her politician boyfriend (Booker Bradshaw) is involved.

programme.title: Baby Einstein - Baby Newton: All About Shapes
programme.desc: With the Dolittle, and other Baby programs under their belts, the tots who follow Julie Aigner-Clark's Baby Einstein series will sidle up to Baby Newton expecting a similar exploration of building blocks to brilliance, but this time there's a wrinkle or two. Animation makes its first appearance, and parents steeped in keep-it-simple culture may object to the springy "I Know My Shapes" song, a departure from classical-only video predecessors.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Communication - EP116
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discover the value and importance of communication. We will learn the correct ways to communicate and the main rules of the good listener. Kent flies Edison’s Awesomobile to France to meet Sheila, but he is mistaken for an alien in a UFO, and the Team Kids must rescue him from an Area 51-type base.

programme.desc: With a few comedic twists and turns, Gisele helps the Secret Millionaire's Club save an orangutan rehabilitation sanctuary in Indonesia.

programme.desc: Miranda makes a cure to cheer up Mia, but she runs out of Happy Bird Eggs!

programme.title: Monster Town - Monster Town - A Contest
programme.desc: Max and Mike argue about who is the strongest monster

programme.title: Argo's World
programme.desc: Join Marie and Argo in this exciting STEM edutainment mixed-media series as they venture through Cyberspace and make discoveries about the world through historical figures and notable real-world personalities! Special guests include a founding father of the Internet, a NASA astronaut, a top robotics expert, and clever folks from M.I.T!

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Chuck the Cherry Picker saves the day!
programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The castle of Robins
programme.desc: Since the lens fails to be recovered, Dr. No wants to make another, but he needs robins to make it. So he attacks Rubidia, a region filled with different precious stones. But Oxin the king of Rubidia makes Dr. No his prisoner. And locked him in the castle where Chip is also locked, as Oxin also makes them prisoners to make them work as slaves in his mines. Dr. No try to make Chip to give him back the lens, but Chip denies. Later, the two manage to escape from the castle and Dr. No chases Chip with his craft. But the boy gets the scientist falls into a trap and also helps free the slaves of Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The harmonica trap
programme.desc: Chip and his friends create a zone with formations resembling musical instruments and make sounds harmonious. Suddenly, they become trapped within a rectangle of quartz crystals that vibrate when they form a sonic trap. A musician atom who has caught them, seeks members to assemble an orchestra. The antimatters are near and Chip asked the musician to prepare the trap to retain them and escape. The musician agrees and the antimatters are prisoners of the musician that makes them hear the terrible sound of his compositions.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL &amp; WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The rare earth
programme.desc: Along the way, Chip and his friends find an island surrounded by a large lake of acid, under the constant threat of eruption of a volcano. In the island lives lanthanide atoms, according to the legend, are awaiting the arrival of a "chosen" to give them acid that prevents them from leaving the island. Chip, thanks to his book, discovers that the volcano emitted a base when mixed with the acid may neutralize and make the dangerous lake in a nice extension of salt water.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - The desert
programme.desc: Across a hot desert Chip and the atoms found themselves with a tungsten atom that gives them refuge under a pyramid-shaped building that, until recently, had an ingenious cooling system through which flowed a stream of ammonia in its basement. But now, Dr. No has diverted the flow of ammonia for his own benefit. Chip discovers the point where ammonia diverts and builds a dam that returns to its normal course.

Yang Guo runs away from home in anger and encounters Ouyang Feng, who teaches him the "Toad Stance" and accidentally unveils his true identity...

programme.desc: Ah Chiao, a village girl stranded in the city, befriends a kind-hearted tramp and a retired actor. They are poor but happy, though Ah Chiao's fortune change for the better when she becomes a singer. However, she soon learns that money cannot buy one happiness...

Wang arranges for her to be Dong's concubine as he knows Dong's adopted son Lu Bu is in love with her, turning them against each other. Lu Bu ends up killing Dong Zuo to be with Diau Charn.

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: In the Yuan Dynasty, martial artists everywhere battle for the Heaven Sword and the Dragon Sabre, as only when these two powerful weapons combine can a secret be revealed to help one become the king of the martial arts world. As Zhang Wu Ji acquires the skills from "Nine Yang Scriptures" by chance, he is also embroiled in this lengthy battle.

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: In this third instalment of Shaw Brother's Journey to the West, Monk Tang San Zang is trapped by seven seductive spider spirits who are hell-bent on achieving immortality by eating him! Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing have to fight the spider spirits to rescue Monk Tang San Zang.

programme.title: The Master
programme.desc: Gao Jian is the disciple of the martial arts master Shi but is constantly being punished by his master for no reason. One day, Gao accidentally saves his master's rival Jin, so Jin teaches him his unique martial arts skill in return. However, Master Shi sees this as Gao's betrayal...

programme.title: The Lotus Lamp
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays both mother and son in this lavish fable about a goddess who falls in love with a mortal scholar (Cheng Pei-pei in her debut role). Over two years in production, it was released on the first anniversary of Linda's tragic suicide.

programme.title: All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: This is a sequel to Chang Cheh's epic "The Water Margin", and follows the patriotic story of seven warriors in the band of 108 outlaws at Mount Liang. The magnificent seven battle against the despotic government officials to save their country.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Wits Of The Brats
programme.desc: Tou Kuan is a wealthy Kwangtung brat with a good kung fu background, he has only one ambition: to pit his wits against three shady masters of the North. The first, conman Che Tsai. The second, a professional romantic dubbed The Terrific. Terrific introduces Tou Kuan to his third rival, Thief Shih San-shou.

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Five Elements Ninjas
programme.desc: The film is about a Chinese martial arts school finds itself outclassed by their rivals, they hire elite ninja from Japan to destroy the school. The lone survivor of the massacre learns the secrets of ninjutsu and seeks revenge against the ninja.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: As Monkey and his gang make their way to the West through Fire Mountain, they ran into the evil Princess Iron Fan, Madam White Bone and her sexy sister, and have to fight their way through.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: One of Shaw Studio's highest grossing movies ever, this is the story of Li Chin Huan, the renowned, charming and sentimental swordsman who must fight many opponents, including an evil Clan Chief, for a place in the martial arts world.

programme.title: Hell Has No Boundary
programme.desc: Cheng Chung (Derek Yee) and May (Liu Hsueh-hua), a pair of lovers working on the police force, camp on an outlying island. Awakened by a strange sound, May goes out onto the beach where a violent frenzy grips her. After her return from leave, May insists Inspector Wang (Yueh Hua) in a bid to rescue some hostages. She shoots the thug under most peculiar circumstances. Then a series of tragedies occur.

programme.title: Hong Kong 73
programme.desc: In 1973, the Hong Kong Heng Seng Index hit extraordinary peaks and people from all walks of life go stock market crazy. Meanwhile, Hong Kong's social problems build up without anyone paying attention to what are actually happening to the crazy lives of people, in this mad city that many call home...

programme.title: The Thundering Sword
programme.desc: Two disciples, Yu and Zheng, are sent by their master to track down the invincible weapon "Thundering Sword" to prevent villains from getting it. Yu encounters the daughter of a ruthless clan, Chiao, who is on her way to seek for the sword. They quickly fall for each other, but when Chiao accidentally injures Zheng, things become complicated.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Pursuit of a Killer
programme.desc: The charm of Pursuit Of A Killer lies in the long awaited reunion of Five Venoms duo, Lo Meng and Sun Chien; Lo Meng, who plays a Mainland Chinese criminal escapee to Hong Kong in search of a better life, and a cop (Sun Chien) who helps him adjust to Hong Kong life while tracking down his mysterious killer at the same time.

programme.title: Puppy Love
programme.desc: To the tune of the Osmonds hit song, this is a story of adolescent playfulness &amp;amp; innocence lost. Two best friends grow up together and teasingly meet two delightfully impish boys leading to the four to flirtatiously intermingle. However, the innocence of partner swapping eventually leads to a roller-coaster bouts of misunderstood emotions.

programme.title: The Singing Killer
programme.desc: Chiang Yi is blackmailed into a jewellery heist by his former boss who threatens to expose his shady past. Complications arise when Chiang Yi discovers his first love working in the jewellery store.

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: Cat VS Rat
programme.desc: Zhan and Bai are equally matched in martial arts skills. Bai saves the Emperor one day but did not believe in his identity and rejects a promotion. When Zhan is promoted to the royal guard after saving the Emperor, Bai gets angry and tries to prank him by stealing the imperial jade seal. Luckily, Zhan is able to retrieve the seal with his skills.

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, &amp;amp; colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: Killer Constable
programme.desc: Kuei Chih-hung was famous for his modern day crime thrillers, his horror flicks, and even his comedies. But if the only kung-fu film he ever made was this one, he'd still be spoken of with respect by even the most ardent martial arts movie fan. Many consider this real life martial arts champion Chen Kuan-tai's best performance. As a deeply, even obsessively, dedicated Chief Court Constable, he illuminates the screen with fighting skill and emotional passion.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: A tragic tale about a young girl who gets married and has five kids. When she and her husband die, leaving all five kids behind to fend for themselves, the eldest child is forced to be sold into prostitution to feed the other four.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang's leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical "Lucky Casino" and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Duel
programme.desc: After knowing his brother has killed the head of a rival triad, Jie takes the blame and was hunted by killers. With the help of Rambler Nan, Jie finally killed his enemies, but then found out that Nan is the one who has killed his father.

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The Millionaire Chase
programme.desc: It's a fun and wild romp that mixes pleasure with pleasure. A nightclub owner, playboy Peter Chen Ho, has his ways with three sisters while gallivanting across Asia. Each one has a dangling relationship to save - ensuring a series of mishaps and comic moments.

They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dong's songs, leading to double bliss for the couple.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: An aging fighter relives the mistakes of his violent past through a poor and streetwise kid, who severely injures his nemesis during a battle to win a girl's heart.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Young Heroes of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Women’s Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Mei’s father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the "corpse whisperer," forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Undercover Hidden Dragon
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, Fat is a gangster who suffers from amnesia. Believing that he is actually an undercover policeman, Fat attempts to arrest gang leader Big Bro, but instead becomes the gangsters’ best ally. To complicate matters further, a gangster named Wind, who looks exactly like Fat, starts a turf war with Big Bro.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Man's best friend.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: Hong Kong Hong Kong
programme.desc: After moving to Hong Kong, illegal immigrant Mang has no choice but to live in cramped quarters with male migrants who abuse her. In order to attain Hong Kong residency and a better life, she agrees to marry a lonely old carpenter. After her marriage, Mang crosses paths again with her ex-lover, and the two develop a passionate affair...

programme.title: PTU
programme.desc: When OCTB (Organized Crime And Triad Bureau) officer, Sergeant Lo Sa, loses his police revolver to four triad young thugs, he seeks help from Sergeant Mike Ho of the PTU (Police Tactical Unit) to find his lost revolver. Ho and his patrolling PTU team has until dawn to recover the gun and clean up the mess.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its "Cop Shop Babes" as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat - can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A gambling master and his partner are hired by the government to investigate another gambler who may be working as a Japanese spy in Shanghai.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh II
programme.desc: Bodyguard Ah Sun is sent to protect his boss' son, only to meet and fall in love with his mistress, the gorgeous Joey. As love blossoms between the two, the powerful boss finds out and all hell breaks loose!

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: A shipment of newly issued currency is robbed by three armed robbers, prompting Detective Chang to investigate. Following new leads, he successfully takes down one of the robbers. Meanwhile, the other two plot to rob a gold factory amidst the chaos. With meticulous planning, Chang thwarts their scheme and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: It's an erotic gore-fest starring Kao Fei who seeks vengeance against his wife's rapists and killers by soliciting the help of a demented magician. In return, he endures copulating dead bodies as his enemies perish in blood spurting and body exploding glory. It's one of Hong Kong goriest films ever made.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Get in the Dark
programme.desc: A reporter hears three horror stories when investigating a case of the paper doll spirit 20 years ago. Miss Qiao had died in vain then, and her butler paid a paper craftsman to make a paper doll to be buried with her. Miss Qiao’s spirit is revived to take revenge when the doll’s eyes are drawn, and a series of horrible events begins to happen...

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua’s hidden identity is accidentally revealed, and he is pursued by a mysterious organization headed by Ah Jie. A fatal duel has just begun!

programme.title: The Sorcerer &amp; The White Snake
programme.desc: In this action fantasy movie based on the Chinese legend of the White Snake, a young herbalist falls in love with a thousand-year-old white snake disguised as a woman. When the white snake's true identity is revealed, a sorcerer goes to battle believing that in doing so, he is restoring balance and order between man and the supernatural.

programme.title: The Gangster, the Cop, the Devil
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from real events. Detective Lin sets up a special unit to arrest the motorbike robber and the crime syndicate behind the thefts in Foshan. In the process, his pregnant wife is hit by a motorbike robber, leading him to uncover their revenge plan...

programme.title: My Darling Genie
programme.desc: A genie who is trapped in a Chinese oil umbrella helps an honorable young man and his uncle to deal with a covetous loan shark.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Whatever You Want
programme.desc: An illegitimate daughter of a businessman gets three wishes from a genie, Bo. However, Bo's magical power is far from perfect, leading to much hilarity in this charming fantasy comedy.

programme.title: Cherie
programme.desc: Cherie Chung plays the title character in this sexy romance as a fitness instructor who attracts the attentions of a wealthy businessman and a handsome photographer.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Final Justice (1988)
programme.desc: Chang is a brilliant police inspector, but his maverick ways have put him at odds with both his superiors and peers. When he encounters Wai, a streetwise car thief who accidentally becomes the key to tracking down a gang of armed bank robbers, the two form an uneasy alliance to bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Inside The Boys
programme.desc: Adapted from a true paranormal event, it is said that people working in the morgue at midnight encounter haunted events as many dead bodies are kept in the college hospital. When a few medical students experience a series of horrifying incidents after leaving the morgue at midnight, the campus is shrouded in terror.

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: The Monkey is Back
programme.desc: The savior of the people, Stone Monkey, has given hope to a desperate little girl which he promises to realize. Years later, Stone Monkey is defeated in a battle with the three-eyed God of War, causing him to lose his power and falls into the mortal world. Can he fulfill his promise to the girl and stop the God of Wood from destroying earth?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Riley’s mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move "Invincible Wind and Fire Spin".

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewife’s debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Let's Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: A girl Marble witnesses a murder case and reports it to the police. After much investigation, the police can only sort out the complicated relationships between a rich merchant's mistress, a postman, a shop owner and his wife, but find no clue as to who the murderer is. Therefore, Marble decides to carry out her own investigation...

programme.title: City of Desire
programme.desc: Sister 13 returns to Macau after 17 years to succeed her father’s underground empire, the prostitution business. She tries to stop their exploitation of the sex workers, but Macau’s economy flourished after the handover, propelling the prostitution and gambling businesses. The city is blinded by desire and Sister 13 can do nothing to help...

programme.title: Look Out, Officer!
programme.desc: Stephen Chow is a delight in this supernatural action comedy, where a murdered police officer returns from beyond the grave to persuade a rookie cop into avenging his death.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: Ma Wing Jing and his brother arrive in Shanghai to make their fortune. Befriending a powerful mobster Tam, Ma is given his nightclub when he saves Tam’s life. Ma’s fortune rises but he must overcome the corruption and violence to survive.

programme.title: Painted Faces
programme.desc: This is based on the real-life story of Master Yu Jim Yuen who strives to run his academy in the 1960s, even as the opera culture is declining.
